headlines.title: Some under-25s should get less benefits, Milburn review to say
headlines.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.

headlines.title: OpenAI reports steep losses despite quarterly revenue rise
headlines.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue rose about 50% to $10 billion in the third quarter. However, the group behind ChatGPT continued to ‌post steep operating losses, according to the Wall Street Journal.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: ‘The only way to get this done’: Why the US wants Europe at Ukraine talks next time
headlines.summary: The truth is, it was never just about Ukraine for Putin. Washington now understands this – and that’s both good for Europe, and potentially terrifying as well.

headlines.title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
headlines.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

headlines.title: New aviation deals raise flight limits between China and Central Asia
headlines.summary: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan agreed to higher weekly flight limits with Beijing, while a separate agreement allows more services between Tashkent, Almaty and Astana. Airlines are also exploring new regional routes, although rising operating costs remain a concern.

headlines.title: Megaspeed and the battle to go high-end Nvidia chips into China
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang s affair with a suspected Chinese spy has shone a light on Megaspeed, the company she worked for. It is under investigation in the US for smuggling Nvidia chips into China, which it denies.

headlines.title: Lagarde would equal any other centrist in Elysée run, poll shows
headlines.summary: The departing ECB president has previously ruled out running in next year's presidential election.

headlines.title: Christmas toy rush being driven by squishies and building sets
headlines.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

headlines.title: Inside Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO: What we know about the AI giant’s plans
headlines.summary: Anthropic plans to raise up to $64 billion (€57.1bn) in its upcoming initial public offering, the artificial intelligence giant said in a filing on Tuesday, in a listing that could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion (€1.25trn).

headlines.title: Why Nvidia CEO s affair with alleged Chinese spy matters for AI race
headlines.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has apologized for an affair with a woman the US believes was spying for China. The story could have profound implications for the world s most valuable company and the global AI race.

headlines.title: SONDAGE EXCLUSIF 2027. Christine Lagarde bien accueillie par les électeurs du centre
headlines.summary: SONDAGE CLUSTER 17 x POLITICO. L'Institut Cluster 17 a testé le scénario d'une candidature à l'élection présidentielle de Christine Lagarde. La future ex-patronne de la BCE, que certains rêvent de voir entrer dans la course, fait d'ores et déjà jeu égal avec Edouard Philippe.

headlines.title: 'Not the answer': Labour MPs speak out against Rosebank as decision looms
headlines.summary: There is a growing expectation among senior Labour figures that drilling in the oil field will be given the green light.

headlines.title: Paraguay's new president vows to recover pension funds at risk in Ueno Bank crisis
headlines.summary: Paraguay’s new president, Pedro Alliana, promises to recover pension funds affected by the intervention in Ueno Bank. The crisis, which led to the dismissal of Santiago Peña, has left up to 7,000 people unemployed in Paraguay and other countries.

headlines.title: Bomb threats hit hundreds of schools in Italy, Ireland and UK
headlines.summary: Italian authorities said it was "likely a cyberattack" rather a "real threat."

headlines.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
headlines.summary: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

headlines.title: Infineon says AI data centre boom to persist despite growing backlash
headlines.summary: Infineon expects soaring demand for chips powering AI infrastructure to sustain growth, despite mounting concerns over the environmental and economic costs of data centre expansion.

headlines.title: EU needs a system to respond to AI incidents, Finland and Estonia say
headlines.summary: In a letter seen by POLITICO, Finland and Estonia call for "EU-level arrangements for responding to serious AI incidents." This comes as European leaders are set to meet Friday to debate AI for the first time.

headlines.title: From Paris to DC - why offices are being turned into apartments
headlines.summary: Office buildings with low occupancy rates are being transformed into flats.

headlines.title: Vodafone suffers huge net loss on Germany hit but raises full-year outlook
headlines.summary: British mobile phone giant Vodafone on Tuesday posted a huge post-tax loss for its first half, linked primarily to a writedown in Germany, but raised its outlook with total revenue increasing.

trend_headline: AI 규제 폭풍과 프랑스 최저임금 인상
summary: EU의 엄격한 디지털 공정법 규제가 유럽 게임 및 빅테크 산업을 압박하는 가운데, 프랑스 정부는 기업 부담 완화 조치와 함께 최저임금 조기 인상을 단행하며 내수 부양에 나섰습니다. 한편, 안트로픽의 대규모 IPO 추진과 인피니언의 AI 데이터센터 수요 낙관론은 거시경제적 불확실성 속에서도 반도체 및 AI 인프라 섹터의 차별화된 모멘텀을 지지하고 있습니다.
key_points: 프랑스 정부, 12월 1일부터 최저임금 월 24유로 인상 및 기업 세제 혜택 발표
EU의 신규 디지털 공정법(Digital Fairness Act) 도입으로 유럽 게임사들 규제 리스크 직면
안트로픽(Anthropic), 최대 640억 달러 규모의 뉴욕증시 IPO 추진으로 AI 생태계 확장 가속화
